decisions.reason: The accent is now derived from the approved Hero V termination, but this derivation does not alter the Hero V geometry itself; the same message's separate silhouette-reference change is already represented.

The accent-specific literal-derivation change does not alter the second V's role or general relationship to the Hero V. The cross-form terminal rule is already owned by REQ_SIGNATURE_TERMINAL_LANGUAGE.
Changing how the É accent is derived does not change the deferred wordmark composition, kerning, or visual-hierarchy requirements.
The source changes accent geometry, not the deferred champagne-metal material treatment or its application sequence.
The literal Hero-V derivation of the É accent does not change the deferred construction or visual language of the remaining internal letterforms.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing one unified terminal gesture across the Hero V, second V, and É accent. The accent's more specific literal-derivation rule remains properly owned by REQ_E_ACCENT_DERIVATION.
The revised accent construction supports the existing proprietary identity goal but does not change any current brand-expression attribute.
The accent derivation does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
